notes.title: Update v0.2.5-demo
notes.notes:
v0.2.5-demo
- Rework tutorial again
- Improve progression by giving stronger units in the shop faster
- Add 11 new improved versions of existing perks
- Add pump ship upgrade
- Reduce max number of missions 16 -> 12
- Jones now starts with swap movement
- Spawn only 2 enemies before 4 fragments
- Buff jump skill to have more range T1 4 -> 4-5, T2 4-6 -> 3-6
- Buff converge to pull ALL object in range, buff T2 range 7 -> 9
- Invisible perk now common
- Improve AP and MP icons look when too many icons
- Improve throw over by showing landing cell
- Add lore intro
- Add final mission confirmation
- Various UI improvements
- Different text and descriptions improvements

notes.title: Update v0.2.4-demo
notes.notes:
v0.2.4
- Rework tutorial
- Spawn only 1 enemy before first fragment collected
- Buff scales 5 credits -> 6 credits
- Add mission time limit tooltip

notes.title: Update v0.2.3
notes.notes: [p]v0.2.3-demo[/p][p]- Rework selection system to allow selecting any unit during turn or placement[/p][p]- Allow selecting other units while movement or skill is active and unit can't be a target[/p][p]- Improve perks progression by removing weak ones in the late game[/p][p]- Nerf rusted hook, effect now is: deals 2 damage randomly split among all enemies[/p][p]- Nerf aliens head, now it gives 6 credits with +3 per stack[/p][p]- Buff focus movement, 1 AP -> 2 AP[/p][p]- Reduce diagonal charge II price and roll chance[/p][p]- Undo button now also cancels active skill or movement[/p][p]- Show hotkey tooltips for some buttons[/p][p]- Small UI improvements[/p][p]- Fix placement cells highlight going out of sync[/p]

notes.title: Stellar Raider DEMO is out!
notes.notes: [p]Very excited to announce that the first public demo for Stellar Raiders is out now![/p][p][/p][p]It includes 3 fully playable starting units, around 100 different skills and perks, and 14 artifacts![/p]

notes.title: Stellar Raiders Playtest is open
notes.notes: [p]You can request access on the Steam page, or join the Discord and ask for a key there![/p]
